comparison.objective: Release and withdraw a connector terminal, versus push a spacer from a covered channel and place it in a nest.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion plus maintained wire/tool contact, versus remote pushing, retrieval, placement, and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits through lock release with no connector damage; versus spacer correctly nested and pusher returned while parts stay on-table.
comparison.reason: Both recover recessed parts, but one tests latch defeat and coordinated tensile extraction while the other tests pushing and placement.
